title: Garage & Workshop
note: Garage and workshop pack (tools/make_garage_assets.py). The size (dimensions_m) comes from the universal _base_dimensions schema.

style.label: Style
style.note: Classic (turned legs, rolled arms, mouldings, brass) or modern (clean lines, slim tapered legs, black metal).

color.label: Colour
color.note: The colour of the painted steel (red, forest, navy, black, grey, orange, white) or of the wood (mahogany, walnut, cherry, oak, birch, white, black).

power_draw_w.label: Power draw (W)
power_draw_w.note: Watts drawn while it runs (the compressor, the grinder).

garage_kind.label: Piece
garage_kind.note: Which piece: workbench, pegboard_wall, sawhorse, shop_stool, lumber_rack_wall, tool_chest_rolling, tool_chest_top, cabinet_tall, cabinet_base, wall_cabinet, steel_shelving, parts_cabinet, air_compressor or bench_grinder.
